headline: School Committee to review truancy and safety strategies, grading system, and grant for school security upgrades.
summary: The School Committee will discuss a field trip to Colleges of the Fenway, truancy and safety strategies, the meeting calendar, middle school football scheduling, workers' compensation fund participation, the grading system, and an SVPP-COPS school security grant. The committee will also enter executive session to discuss a personnel matter.
items: Vote on field trip request to Colleges of the Fenway in Boston, MA
Review of truancy and safety strategies
Review of School Committee meeting calendar, with possible vote
Review of Middle School Football Schedule Challenges, with possible vote
Vote on joining Maine Municipal Association Workers' Compensation fund
Vote on submitting SVPP-COPS grant for school security systems and access points
Executive session on a personnel matter under 1 M.R.S.A. §405(6)(A)
Possible vote on executive session item
location: The Green Ladle, 156 East Ave., Lewiston
plain_text:
** AGENDA** 
SCHOOL COMMITTEE MEETING SCHEDULED FOR MONDAY, AUGUST 3, 2026 
AT THE GREEN LADLE, 156 EAST AVE., LEWISTON 
Note:  
*A review of all general session meetings can be located at www.lewistonpublicschools.org or copies can be requested at a cost of 10 
cents per page.   
**This Agenda includes estimated time for each agenda item which is being used only as a guide to keep the meeting on schedule. 
***Video Notice: This meeting is being recorded and can be viewed on the internet from a link at www.lewistonpublicschools.org 
 
1. Call meeting to order on or about 5:30 pm until approximately 8:30. Pledge of Allegiance. 
 
2. School Committee Member Introductions. 
 
3. Consent Agenda: (a) Personnel 
 
4. Public Input: (Note: Members of the public may address the School Committee for up to 3 minutes on non-agenda 
items now and on agenda items later. Speakers must adhere to our public comment policy (BEDH), which is 
available in the back of the room or on the LPS website. These meetings exist to conduct school committee business. 
The purpose of public comment is to share thoughts on school and educational matters. Committee members and 
school staff will not reply during this time. Comments must be directed to the Chair and be civil. By law, comments 
may not pertain to specific staff or students; comments about individuals must be directed privately to the 
appropriate LPS staff. Student privacy must be maintained. The public comment period is 30 minutes unless 
extended due to unusual circumstances. Priority goes to Lewiston residents and parents, students, or employees of 
LPS. Before starting, please state your name, town/city of residence, and affiliation to LPS. 
 
5. To receive and potentially vote on the field trip request to attend Colleges of the Fenway in Boston, MA. 
 
6. Review of multiple strategies in place for truancy and safety as part of systems overview. 
 
7. To review School Committee Meeting Calendar and Discussion with potential vote. 
 
8. To review Middle School Football Schedule Challenges with potential vote. 
 
9. To resolve providing for participation in the Maine Municipal Association Workers’ Compensation fund with 
potential vote. 
 
10. To review contexts behind current grading system as part of systems overview. 
 
11. Receive and approve request for submitting an SVPP-COPS grant to improve school security systems and access 
points. 
 
12. Report from School Committee Chair. 
 
13. Report from School Superintendent. 
 
14. Report from the City Council Rep.
15. Updates from School Committee Subcommittees. 
 
16. School Committee Community Announcements.  
 
17. Future agenda items. 
 
18. To enter into executive session to discuss a personnel matter in accordance with 1 M.R.S.A. §405(6)(A). 
 
19. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
20. Adjourn. 
 
ADA Notice: This school district will accommodate members of the public with special needs to participate fully in this 
meeting. Please contact Executive Assistant Cheryl Cornelio (795-4100, Ext.4002) if you have such needs.
